meta.title: Jujutsu Shenanigans Skill Builder Nodes data

imagePolicy.reason: Skill Builder rows are configuration/reference rows. Parent approved hiding images by default instead of using weak per-row UI screenshots.

sources.label: JJS Skill Builder - How to Make Custom Moves
JJS Skill Builder - How to Use JJS Skill Builder

exclusions.name: Known Tricks as standalone rows
exclusions.reason: The source warns that some tricks may be outdated or purposeless, so they are not counted as durable catalog rows. Stable trick context can be folded into notes later when tied to a specific row.

exclusions.name: Per-row screenshots
exclusions.reason: Parent approved hiding images by default; this is a builder reference catalog rather than an item-art catalog.

items.name: Wait
items.purpose: Adds a pause before the next node runs.
items.defaultOrRange: Default 1 second.
items.usedFor: Line up hitboxes, visuals, sounds, cancels, branch checks, and variant timing.
items.notes: The source uses Wait as the basic timing spacer for Skill Builder sequences.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Skill
items.purpose: Runs one of the game's existing skills inside the custom move.
items.defaultOrRange: Speed, Cancel Last, Enable Variants, Hold For, and Start. Enable Variants is on by default.
items.usedFor: Reuse normal character skills, trigger skill variants, or start a move at a later point.
items.notes: Speed 0 stops the skill from performing normally, though some effects may still appear.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Special
items.purpose: Runs one of the game's existing special moves.
items.defaultOrRange: Speed, Cancel Last, and Variants. Specials do not have Hold For.
items.usedFor: Build custom specials or combine special behavior with timeline cancels.
items.notes: The current issues section warns that some specials or related moves can break custom moves.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Animation
items.purpose: Plays a selected skill, special, melee, awakening, or emote animation.
items.defaultOrRange: Slider, Speed, Loop, Fade In, Fade Out, and Last Hit. Speed defaults to 1.
items.usedFor: Give the custom move a pose, motion, target animation, loop, or smoother transition.
items.notes: Loop lasts until another Animation node is reached; without a later node, the source says it will not loop.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Sound
items.purpose: Plays a custom audio ID when the timeline reaches the node.
items.valueType: Roblox audio ID plus playback settings
items.defaultOrRange: Volume defaults to 0.5, Speed defaults to 1, Start defaults to 0, End defaults to 500.
items.usedFor: Add feedback, cancel matching sounds, make audio global, or attach a sound to a projectile tag.
items.notes: The source points builders to the Roblox Creator Store for working audio IDs.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Velocity
items.purpose: Controls user or target movement during the custom move.
items.valueType: XYZ force, time, and movement toggles
items.defaultOrRange: Force defaults to 0 on X, Y, and Z. Time is measured in seconds.
items.usedFor: Dash, launch, pull, float, track facing direction, or apply ragdoll movement.
items.notes: The current issues section says Velocity over about 1000 can make the player jitter.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Connect
items.purpose: Sends an activation signal to matching Connect Blocks.
items.defaultOrRange: Uses a Signal value, duration, and proximity range.
items.usedFor: Trigger Build Mode contraptions from a custom move.
items.notes: The source compares Signal to the ID system used by Logic Blocks.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Hitbox
items.purpose: Creates an area that affects targets when the keyframe is reached.
items.valueType: Position, size, damage, stun, attack type, blocking, and branch settings
items.defaultOrRange: Position defaults to 0,0,4; Size defaults to 6 studs.
items.usedFor: Deal damage, stun, break debris, choose counterability, trigger branches, or attach to a projectile.
items.notes: Any Debree value over 0 can harm domains according to the source.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Branch
items.purpose: Triggers a named branch or random branch path.
items.valueType: Branch name or comma-separated random branch list
items.defaultOrRange: Random branch lists use comma-separated names without spaces, such as A,B,C.
items.usedFor: Build move variants, hit-cancel paths, air/ground versions, or random outcomes.
items.notes: Properties are global across branches and cannot be changed per branch as of the source revision.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Visual
items.purpose: Creates a custom visual effect for a chosen amount of time.
items.valueType: Effect picker, color, opacity, position, rotation, size, time, tags, and easing
items.defaultOrRange: Color and Alt Color default to 255,255,255; Opacity uses 0 as visible and 1 as invisible; Size defaults to 1.
items.usedFor: Add VFX, camera effects, mesh/billboard effects, projectile-attached visuals, or cancel tagged visuals.
items.notes: Some effects need specific settings, such as Dismantle and Mass Hit needing Position and Alt Position.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Grab
items.purpose: Sticks one of a target's body parts to the user's body after damage is dealt.
items.valueType: Limb, target limb, position, rotation, time, and Last Hit
items.defaultOrRange: Time defaults to 1. Last Hit defaults to -1.
items.usedFor: Hold a target in place for follow-up animation, damage, or branch timing.
items.notes: The current issues section says Grab can teleport the user if the ability ends before stun registers; adding a Wait for the grab duration can fix that case.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Projectile
items.purpose: Creates a moving hitbox that travels from one place to another.
items.valueType: Projectile tag, position, size, velocity, gravity, time, and hit behavior
items.defaultOrRange: Uses Projectile Tag to connect visuals, sounds, and hitboxes to the same projectile.
items.usedFor: Make ranged attacks, moving collision, or projectile-attached effects.
items.notes: The approved data shape keeps projectile-specific rows together with tags so builders can see what links to it.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Counter
items.purpose: Creates a counter check without normal animations or damage.
items.valueType: Attack type, time, stun, and enemy cancel settings
items.defaultOrRange: Attack types include Melee, Bullet, Explosion, Swarm, and Domain.
items.usedFor: React to incoming attacks and optionally stun or interrupt the attacker.
items.notes: Multiple attack types can be countered when configured.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Tag
items.purpose: Adds or checks a temporary tag on the user.
items.defaultOrRange: Tags last for a chosen period of time.
items.usedFor: Create temporary variables for variants, cooldown bypasses, branch checks, or chained move logic.
items.notes: The source describes tags as variables that latch onto a player.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: State
items.purpose: Applies a state to the user.
items.valueType: State picker and duration or multiplier settings
items.defaultOrRange: States include Stun, IFrame, NoM1, NoSprint, NoJump, NoDash, DisableChase, Block, DirectionLock, SpeedMultiplier, JumpMultiplier, and more.
items.usedFor: Control movement, blocking, invulnerability, chase, speed, jump, or stun behavior during a custom move.
items.notes: Use short state rows on cards; the full state list is too long for public card prose.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Add Awakening
items.purpose: Adds awakening resource to the user.
items.defaultOrRange: Uses a chosen amount.
items.usedFor: Reward or drain move flow around awakening-based custom behavior.
items.notes: Keep this separate from Properties; it changes resource during the timeline.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Add Health
items.purpose: Adds or removes health when the timeline reaches the node.
items.defaultOrRange: Can target the user or recent target. Single Target controls target scope.
items.usedFor: Make healing, recoil, self-damage, or target health effects.
items.notes: Unlike Hitbox self-damage, the source distinguishes health effects from lethal hitbox damage behavior.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Add Evasive
items.purpose: Adds evasive resource or behavior to the custom move flow.
items.defaultOrRange: Uses a chosen amount.
items.usedFor: Tie a custom move to evasive resource behavior.
items.notes: Use this as a timeline resource row, not a global move property.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Hit Cancel
items.purpose: Cancels the remaining custom move when prior stun or damage has happened in its checked window.
items.defaultOrRange: Time dictates the checked frame window.
items.usedFor: Stop a move after hit confirmation, build blockable starts, or route hit and miss branches.
items.notes: The current issues section says Hit Cancel can register stun from outside the custom move if Time goes beyond startup.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Loop
items.purpose: Loops a section of timeline behavior.
items.defaultOrRange: Uses Fade In, Fade Out, and Last Hit settings in the source row.
items.usedFor: Repeat a move segment or keep a custom effect running until a later point.
items.notes: Use with care because repeated timeline behavior can make debugging harder.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: In Air
items.purpose: Gates a custom ability or branch by grounded versus airborne state.
items.defaultOrRange: True side: ground-only. False side: airborne-only.
items.usedFor: Split ground and air variants.
items.notes: The source table names true and false sides, so cards should preserve the side labels instead of guessing the UI wording.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Is Jumping
items.purpose: Gates use by whether the jump input is being held.
items.defaultOrRange: True side: not holding jump. False side: holding jump.
items.usedFor: Make hold-jump alternate starts.
items.notes: The source table names true and false sides, so cards should preserve the side labels instead of guessing the UI wording.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Has Target
items.purpose: Gates use by whether a valid target is in sight through the cursor.
items.defaultOrRange: True side: no valid target in sight. False side: valid target in sight.
items.usedFor: Separate lock-on or no-target behavior.
items.notes: The source table names true and false sides, so cards should preserve the side labels instead of guessing the UI wording.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Is Awakened
items.purpose: Gates use by base state versus awakening state.
items.defaultOrRange: True side: base state. False side: awakening state.
items.usedFor: Make base-only or awakening-only custom moves.
items.notes: The source table names true and false sides, so cards should preserve the side labels instead of guessing the UI wording.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Has Awk Bar
items.purpose: Checks the user's awakening percentage against a chosen amount.
items.defaultOrRange: Default 5%. True side: less than or equal. False side: greater than or equal.
items.usedFor: Lock moves behind awakening meter checks.
items.notes: The source table names true and false sides, so cards should preserve the side labels instead of guessing the UI wording.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Durability
items.purpose: Gives the custom ability or branch a use limit.
items.defaultOrRange: Default 1. The source says the false side cannot be toggled.
items.usedFor: Erase or expire custom moves after limited uses.
items.notes: The source table names true and false sides, so cards should preserve the side labels instead of guessing the UI wording.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Is In Domain
items.purpose: Gates use by whether the user is inside a domain.
items.defaultOrRange: True side: outside a domain. False side: inside a domain.
items.usedFor: Make domain-only or outside-domain variants.
items.notes: The source table names true and false sides, so cards should preserve the side labels instead of guessing the UI wording.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Has Health
items.purpose: Checks the user's health against a chosen amount.
items.defaultOrRange: True side: less than or equal. False side: greater than or equal.
items.usedFor: Trigger low-health or high-health behavior.
items.notes: The source table names true and false sides, so cards should preserve the side labels instead of guessing the UI wording.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Is Holding
items.purpose: Gates use by whether the player is holding the keybind.
items.defaultOrRange: True side: not holding the keybind. False side: holding the keybind.
items.usedFor: Build hold-input custom behavior.
items.notes: The source table names true and false sides, so cards should preserve the side labels instead of guessing the UI wording.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Damage Multiplier
items.purpose: Multiplies the custom ability's overall damage.
items.defaultOrRange: Chosen value.
items.usedFor: Tune total damage after the timeline is built.
items.notes: Properties apply to the custom move as a whole rather than one timeline moment.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Knockback Multiplier
items.purpose: Multiplies the custom ability's overall knockback.
items.defaultOrRange: Chosen value.
items.usedFor: Tune launch or push strength across the move.
items.notes: Properties apply to the custom move as a whole rather than one timeline moment.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Invincible
items.purpose: Grants total i-frames while the ability runs.
items.defaultOrRange: On or off.
items.usedFor: Protect the user during a custom move.
items.notes: Properties apply to the custom move as a whole rather than one timeline moment.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Replace Skill if Occupied
items.purpose: Lets the custom move replace an already occupied move slot.
items.defaultOrRange: On or off.
items.usedFor: Force a custom move into a chosen Moveset Block slot.
items.notes: Properties apply to the custom move as a whole rather than one timeline moment.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Prevent Override
items.purpose: Prevents another ability from replacing this custom ability through replacement behavior.
items.defaultOrRange: On or off.
items.usedFor: Protect an installed custom move from being overwritten.
items.notes: Properties apply to the custom move as a whole rather than one timeline moment.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Hide in Awakening
items.purpose: Hides the custom ability while the user is in awakening.
items.defaultOrRange: On or off.
items.usedFor: Keep a move base-only.
items.notes: Properties apply to the custom move as a whole rather than one timeline moment.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Keep When Moveset Switches
items.purpose: Keeps the custom ability when the user's moveset switches between base and awakening.
items.defaultOrRange: On or off.
items.usedFor: Carry custom move access through form switching.
items.notes: Properties apply to the custom move as a whole rather than one timeline moment.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Hide in Base
items.purpose: Hides the custom ability while the user is in base state.
items.defaultOrRange: On or off.
items.usedFor: Keep a move awakening-only.
items.notes: Properties apply to the custom move as a whole rather than one timeline moment.
items.verificationNote: Normalized from the canonical Skill Builder page.

items.name: Use When Obtained

items.usedFor: Trigger automatic move behavior from obtainment.

items.name: Use On Death

items.defaultOrRange: On or off.

items.name: No Stun

items.name: No Cancel
